grading.how_grading_works: GRADING IS COMPUTED AT READ TIME, NOT STORED. No table holds a win/loss column. (a) Telegram ledger .telegram-delivery.sqlite: deliveries (status sending/sent/retry/failed/uncertain) plus append-only best_picks (backend/app/best_pick_record.py), one row per card the job sent, holding a JSON 'picture' with forecast_id, market, side and pick_label for each pick on the card. best_picks records only NBA/NHL/NFL cards that returned 'sent'. Soccer cards and 'uncertain' cards get no row. named_forecast_id is NULL on all 24 rows (the v4 rule named no pick), so a card's headline pick must be matched through the picture by pick_label. (b) Sport stores: games (status, home_score, away_score), game_forecasts (NBA/NHL/NFL: p_a/p_mid/p_b, line, generated_at, tipoff_at), soccer_live_forecasts and soccer_matches. (c) Scorecard stores scorecard/<sport>.sqlite: append-only context rows (book quote, opening line, lineup, rest) per forecast_id, written by python -m app.scorecard sync (LaunchAgent every 120 s). They store no results; results are joined from the store on read. (d) Grading logic: backend/app/coverage.py grade() calls markets.settle(market, line, status, home, away, decision, tipoff_at, forecast_tipoff_at) and compares to pick_side(). It returns win/loss/push/pending/void/unscorable/unresolved (unresolved after 48 h with no final). coverage.canonical picks one forecast per game and market on read; coverage.games_report and ledger_grading feed the History and Performance pages; paper_trading.py grades paper bets; scripts/best_picks.py grades best_picks for NBA/NHL only after 100 decided named picks (pre-registered, no interim looks). So 'graded' effectively means 'game is final in the store'. I re-graded every card myself with markets.settle (imported, read-only) from the snapshot, using each card's 'Recommended pick' label. Cards counted: 52 pick cards (39 sent + 14 uncertain = 53 rows, minus 1 welcome message). Scorecard coverage: every game_forecasts row with status forecast has a scorecard row (NBA 149/149, NHL 44/44, NFL 60/60, soccer live 102/102; 0 missing, 0 orphans), and the writer was current within about 2 min of the snapshot.
